title: Travis CI API token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character replaced by _, which trufflehog admits and gitleaks does not; outside the contract's [A-Za-z0-9] intersection (recorded peer difference). Twin of "Travis CI API token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
